parameters.name: regionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region in which the instance resides.

parameters.name: resourceGroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the resource group to which the instance is changed.

You can call the [ListResourceGroups](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/resource-management/latest/listresourcegroups) operation to query existing resource groups.

parameters.name: resourceId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource. Set this parameter to the ID of the ApsaraMQ for RocketMQ instance whose resource group you want to change.

parameters.name: resourceType
parameters.description:
The type of resource.

Set this parameter to **instance**. The value of this parameter cannot be changed.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun rocketmq change-resource-group --resource-id c2c5d1274a8d4317a13bc5b0d4000000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type instance --resource-group-id rg-9gLOoK0000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun rocketmq POST /resourceGroup/change --region cn-hangzhou --resourceId c2c5d1274a8d4317a13bc5b0d4000000 --regionId 'cn-hangzhou' --resourceGroupId 'rg-9gLOoK0000' --resourceType instance --header "Content-Type=application/json"
